4.3_bot_policy_or_agent_docs.note: No explicit bot policy or robots.txt. However, dev docs FAQ mentions Context7 MCP integration for AI access to SDKs/API docs, and SDKs are published on npm/PyPI for programmatic trading. Agent-awareness exists but no formal bot/agent access policy.

summary: predict.fun scores 9/15 (grade C). Strong documentation ecosystem with docs.predict.fun (user guides), dev.predict.fun (full REST API with SDK references), and llms.txt on the docs subdomain. SDKs available in TypeScript and Python, with Context7/MCP integration for AI-assisted development. However, Cloudflare blocks all non-browser agents with 403, there is no robots.txt, only 2 semantic HTML tags, and no formal bot/agent access policy. The CF wall is the primary barrier to agent accessibility.
